entries.172c221372ce6ed7: A platform for corporate customers to utilize generative AI. entries.25dd8ce1e0622a60: A business support tool specialized in responding to inquiries from inside and outside the company. By accumulating conversation logs and improving answer accuracy through AI machine learning, it automates part of the work that people previously handled by phone or email. No separate disclosure of amounts.
entries.3dba670a1a1ca5dd: This is a comprehensive digital marketing tool that supports the operation of Web sites. It has functions such as automatic content creation by generative AI, visualization of user behavior through heat maps, and pop-up delivery to prevent drop-offs and improve conversion. There is no separate disclosure of the amount.
entries.46711f4ed87d8522: This is a single-segment business that provides platform services using big data and artificial intelligence (AI). It provides "User Insight," a comprehensive digital marketing tool that supports Web site operation, "Social Insight," a social media analysis tool, "Support Chatbot," a tool supporting inquiry responses, "User Local ChatAI," a generative AI tool for corporations, and others. All are provided in SaaS form, and are structured so that, as use increases, data accumulates and leads to improvements in AI accuracy and analysis capabilities. Net sales for the fiscal year ended June 2026 were ¥5,343 million.
entries.54f2d977375204ed: Net income for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥1,634 million, up 14.4% from the previous year.
entries.56db82b21a32ab5d: Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥5,343 million, up 16.6% from the previous year. It has a single segment, the data cloud business.

entries.7931cdafb2899a3d: It provides a service structured so that as users increase, more data accumulates and the accuracy and analytical capability of its AI improve. In access analysis, a feature is that analysis results are shown intuitively, for example by visualizing users' on-page behavior in a thermography-like manner using heat maps. In research and development, it focuses on three points: expanding its proprietary AI algorithms, implementing AI algorithms in existing services, and developing new AI services.

entries.f948ed7738ed459b: Under its management philosophy 'Evolving the world with big data × artificial intelligence', it aims for a society in which everyone benefits from automation and efficiency, using data analysis and AI technologies to solve various issues. As its future policy, it focuses on three points: expanding its proprietary AI algorithms, implementing AI algorithms in existing services, and developing new AI services. While leveraging its strengths of providing high value-added services and securing and developing talented people, it aims for sustainable medium- to long-term growth by investing management resources in business areas where markets are expected to expand. As an issue to be addressed, it cites securing and developing talented people, including AI engineers and data scientists.
